count_report_view_records.description: Count the documents a reporting view template matches for the same filters as 'Run report view', and how many pages that is.

parameters.description: The reporting view template to run, such as 'Requisition_SAP_createdRange'. System templates are named DocumentType_SAP|PeopleSoft|Generic_createdRange|updatedRange.

parameters.description: Which date 'From' and 'To' apply to. It must match the template: a 'createdRange' template filters on the created date, an 'updatedRange' one on the updated date.
parameters.name: date_field

parameters.description: Start of the window. SAP Ariba reads at most 31 days at a time; with no dates and no document ids, the last 31 days are read.
parameters.name: date_from

parameters.description: End of the window, at most 31 days after 'From'.
parameters.name: date_to

parameters.description: Only include documents with this status, such as Approved or Ordered.
